in_marathi.name: Parimal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Perfect, Immaculate, Pure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parimal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parimal is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'pari' meaning 'perfect' or 'immaculate'. This name signifies a pure and perfect being. In Hindu mythology, Parimal is a name of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, who embodies the qualities of purity, wisdom, and power. The name is believed to bring blessings of good luck, prosperity, and spiritual growth.
